name: Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor
description: This 5,000 km stretch of the ancient Silk Road runs from the old Han and Tang capitals of Chang'an and Luoyang in China to the Zhetysu region of Central Asia, crossing China, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan. Its 33 sites include ruined cities, Buddhist cave temples, beacon towers, mountain passes and sections of the Great Wall. Together they trace a trade route that carried goods, religions and ideas for some 1,500 years.
